title: Hockessin Area Community Meeting
description:
Worried about the world but not sure what to do? Want to help create change or protect communities you care about? Come join us! We’re local residents looking for others who want to come together, support each other, and take action. Help us make a different on issues like:
 
- Protecting our local LGBTQ+ and immigrant communities
- Demanding that politicians fight for us—not for corporations and big donors
- Advocating for policies that uplift working families
- Ensuring safe streets, strong schools, and a healthy environment
- Building a fun, supportive space for people who care about these issues!  
 
Our monthly meetings are organized in tandem with the Delaware Working Families Party, which is part of a national movement to build a political party that is multiracial, working-class, grassroots, and feminist. Unlike other third parties, the Working Families Party understands the limits of third parties and uses several strategies to overcome those limits. Come to the meeting to find out more!  
 
- Open to anyone interested, especially if you live, work, or attend school in the Hockessin/Yorklyn area.
- All ages welcome. Parents can bring infants, toddlers, kids. Students & young adults–we need you, too!
- Snacks and refreshments provided.
- If you’re interested but can’t make it, please email wfp.hockessin@gmail.com to connect!

Please RSVP on this page so we know how many people to expect!

title: League of Women Voters of Miami-Dade Annual Meeting, Board Installation Ceremony 2025–2026

sponsor.name: League of Women Voters of Miami-Dade County

description:
The League of Women Voters of Miami-Dade County invites the public to its Annual Meeting, Board Installation Ceremony and Program Launch for 2025–2026 on Saturday, June 28, from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. at the historic Miami Springs Woman's Club, 200 Westward Dr, Miami Springs, FL 33166.
This engaging event brings together community members, League supporters and civic leaders to celebrate progress, welcome new board members, and share the organization’s upcoming initiatives. Guests will hear about the League’s 2025–2026 priorities while enjoying a vibrant, empowering atmosphere designed to encourage networking, inspiration and fun.
Tickets are available on Eventbrite and proceeds will support nonpartisan voter education efforts such as Vote411.org, as well as programs aimed at increasing informed civic participation across Miami-Dade County. The League does not endorse any candidate or political party—every dollar raised helps protect and strengthen our democracy.
Since 1985, the League of Women Voters of Miami-Dade has served as a powerful grassroots network dedicated to empowering voters and defending democracy. As a women-led, nonpartisan organization, the League acts as a vital liaison between government and the people, committed to fostering an inclusive, informed and engaged community.
Join us for a morning of purpose, progress—and people power. Come network. Come have fun. Come make a difference.
For tickets and more information, visit www.eventbrite.com/e/league-of-women-voters-of-miami-dade-annual-meeting-tickets-1384624030749.

title: PA: Power to the People: Protecting Your Community With Local Zoning
description:
Join Food & Water Watch’s Municipal Ordinance Project for an eye-opening webinar on how communities can harness the power of local zoning laws to stop dangerous and unnecessary fossil fuel projects before they start. As well pads, pipelines, power plants, and other fossil fuel infrastructure continue to threaten our health, environment, and climate, local governments hold a powerful — and often underutilized — tool to fight back.

In this webinar, we’ll break down:

- How local zoning works and why it matters

- Real-world examples of communities successfully using zoning to halt rampant fossil fuel development

- Legal considerations and organizing strategies to pass protective local ordinances

- How you can get involved in this growing movement for environmental justice and local democracy

This event is perfect for activists, local officials, community leaders, and anyone concerned about fossil fuel development in their neighborhood.

description:
As many of you have probably heard, a twelve-day protest march from Philadelphia to Washington DC is planned for later this month! Full details can be found at: Democracy12.

Indivisible Frederick MD is planning to take part in the final days of the march! Come on, let's Make History Together!  We plan to be taking part in this amazing moment on June 25th through the 28th!  Details on the route can be found here: Democracy12 Route.

Be sure to bring ample water, snacks, a change of socks, any medications you might need, comfortable shoes or boots you can walk in, your charged phone and a means to recharge it (if you have one), a broad-brimmed hat, rain gear, sunglasses, sunscreen, and so on! Our support vehicle (on the days when it is operating) will be stocked with bottled water, snacks, a large first-aid kit with special attention paid to treatments for sore feet and sunburn, sunscreen, clean socks, hand sanitizer, wipes, umbrellas, extra sign-making supplies, etc.

Walk a little or a lot; walk one day or four (or twelve!); walk or drive a support vehicle but come and be part of this incredible attempt to show the nation and the world that we are On the Move!

title: NO KINGS DAY I-91 Overpass Standout - Mtn Park Rd, Holyoke
description:
It's NO KINGS DAY! Why wouldn't we be on the overpass?

### Recent DOT Visits

A Department of Transportation employee has visited twice in the past three weeks prior to 5/20 to ask that people NOT attach anything to the fencing. On 5/20, he parked and waited until everything was removed from the fencing. It seems reasonable to expect that DOT enforcement will continue.

### How to Get There

The address "9 Mountain Park Rd, Holyoke" will get you there if you're using Waze. (Mountain Park Road runs off Route 5, and is not accessible from I-91.) People have reported that some GPS systems bring you right under the bridge, but on I-91. That’s annoying!

Please park on the side of the road before the bridge. We can't park on the bridge.

### Other Stuff

Please take everything you brought away with you, and leave the site totally clean.

If rain is predicted, we'll cancel. If we cancel, you'll receive an email notification.

We may see a counter protester. If so, the best thing to do is just ignore them and spend our time and energy waving to motorists. Let's keep things 100% non-confrontational in words and body language.

### A Few Requests

We've found that roof rake sections make wonderful flagpoles and banner poles. If you have a roof rake (or 10’-15’ light metal poles or conduit) to contribute, we'll be happy to take it off your hands!

Donations...we've purchased banners and grommets and flags and zip ties and bungee cords, and we'll be getting more. We’ve purchased 20” x 30” letter boards for messaging we can change. All this costs $$$. We'll have a bucket for donations, and if you could throw something in, that'd be great. And if not, that's perfectly OK, too - your presence is what's really important. See where the money's going! https://tinyurl.com/IN-SLWMProtestTeamFinancials

title: Vigil and Petition for the Disappeared in America

location.venue: Stroudsburg area (meeting location to be announced)

description:
After reading this information, it's critical that you sign up so you can receive updates, as important details such as time and location are still being decided.

Stroudsburg and the Poconos join the national day of action organized by the Not Above the Law coalition to help raise awareness about the disappearances, detentions and deportations being conducted by the Trump administration without due process.

For our quiet and peaceful vigil, we will assemble at a location in the Stroudsburg area (to be announced) and each hold a poster with an image of a person who was been disappeared.

[Sign the petition to the National Sheriffs Association](https://act.faithfulamerica.org/sign/NSA-ICE/)

We will be mourning the personal loss of these individuals, their families and communities, and mourning the great loss that is felt across America - the loss of basic humanity and morality which could not be more evident in the actions being taken by the administration and their accomplices.

[Disappeared in America](https://disappearedinamerica.com)

It is critical that we demonstrate that Americans across the country stand in opposition to the violation of due process, and in support of those who are being targeted by the Trump administration, and that we take actions to awaken and inform our local community about the potential for harm if our authorities collaborate in these illegal and immoral acts.

This crisis is not just about the personal ordeals of families across the country – it affects each and every one of us in the Poconos.  The Trump administration has already floated the idea of kidnapping and deporting U.S. citizens — and if they can defy the courts in one case, they can do it in others.

Please sign up to receive updates about the time and location of our vigil.
